column8: Go deeper into the caverns and kill a Skeleton Fremennik for a key.
Search the picture wall in the north room.
Pick up 2 rotten barrels and 6 ropes from around the room.
WALK onto the walkway to the east, and use a barrel on it to repair it.
WALK on the walkway and repair the next hole in it.
Open the gate on the walkway, clicking the key hole which matches your key.
WALK off the remaining walkway, and search the chest in the wreck. Be prepared to fight Ulfric.
Kill Ulfric.
Search the chest again to finish the quest.
